text_block_list.name: Vassals
text_block_list.text: "Lady Orfevre!! Happy Valentine's Day!!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Now then, show me what you've achieved 
this year.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer A
text_block_list.text:
Every year on Valentine's Day, our 
subjects come together to present us with 
chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainer B
text_block_list.text:
Not only the flavor, but to please the 
eyes of the King... we spent an entire 
year planning and crafting it. Every year, 
the scale grows even larger—

—Told that there was no longer enough room 
indoors this year, I was guided all the 
way up to the rooftop...

text_block_list.name: Artistic Vassal
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer-san. I am your personal 
court painter.

text_block_list.name: Artistic Vassal
text_block_list.text:
Without further ado!! By all means!! 
Please have a look!! This is this year's 
chocolate tribute...!

At that moment, the giant white sheet 
draped in the back was pulled 
away—revealing the entire picture.

text_block_list.name: Artistic Vassal
text_block_list.text:
"—This piece is titled... 'The Trajectory 
of Lord Orfevre.'"

A sigh of admiration escaped my lips. It 
was a painting... A massive masterpiece 
across eleven canvases, depicting Orfevre 
in various forms.

text_block_list.name: Artistic Vassal
text_block_list.text:
I used chocolate pens to depict the 
trajectory of Lady Orfevre's journey up to 
this day—using painterly motifs.

No matter how you look at it, it's a 
beautiful piece of art. The details are 
exquisite, the colors rich... It's hard to 
believe it was drawn with a chocolate pen.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Ho...

text_block_list.name: Artistic Vassal
text_block_list.text: !! The King's admiration...!

text_block_list.name: Artistic Vassal
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, my life has truly been splendid... 
That is all from me, farewell...
choice_data_list: You haven't told me what you thought yet!?
You haven't told me what you thought yet!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...That picture is from the Make Debut. 
The one over there is... the Japanese 
Derby?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Truly, a magnificent sight. You have done 
well.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainers
text_block_list.text: !!! *Bows down reverently*!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It is a royal decree.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
All of my great deeds yet to come— depict 
them in full, and present them to me.

text_block_list.name: Artistic Vassal
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes, absolutely! From now on, I will 
continue to depict... Lady Orfevre's great 
achievements!! With chocolate!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —And what about you?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
My subjects have made their offerings. 
What of you?

...It seems I'm also expected to give a 
Valentine's present. I hadn't thought 
about it, but first of all—
choice_data_list:
(Following up a masterpiece like that, 
huh...?!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
“—I had a look beforehand as well... It 
was truly a masterpiece again this year.”
choice_data_list: ...By the way, what are you giving?
...By the way, what are you giving?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"I gave it to him first thing in the 
morning. It has become a yearly tradition 
for me to gift him homemade sweets."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It's very simple, but... I brought some 
extra-sweet chocolate, just the way Orfe 
likes it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Chocolates from my sister and my retainers 
are more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You must offer me something far more 
lavish than what my vassals present.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Before Valentine's Day comes to an end.

...I was in quite a bind. It was already 
afternoon, and considering the preparation 
time, there was no time to hesitate—

And so, venturing out into the city full 
of enthusiasm... we immediately found a 
clue.

There was only a single poster taped to a 
utility pole, with no other details... 
Even after searching on social media, no 
information came up.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that? Curious about it? An elderly 
pyrotechnician is just putting on a small, 
private show for the neighborhood folks.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
If you promise not to tell anyone, want me 
to tell you the time? Though—it's tonight, 
actually.

Once night fell... keeping the destination 
a secret, I managed to drive Orfevre out 
to a spot with a clear view of the 
fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Kept me waiting a whole day, huh?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
You seem remarkably confident. I take it I 
may have high expectations?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What did you say?
choice_data_list: Still, I wanted to show you.
Still, I really wanted to show you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You want to show me?
(Gloom...!)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I see. Fireworks, huh?

One firework after another launches into 
the sky. In the clear winter air, the 
fireworks look so vivid and brilliantly 
bright—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

Right at that moment— an exceptionally 
large firework burst into the sky.

—A colossal, heart-shaped firework burst 
across the sky.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Was that what you wanted to show me?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"So your loyalty to me is less than that, 
you say."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Now then. I doubt it is more lavish than 
what my subjects possess, but...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Not bad for an offering. It gets a 
passing grade."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Still, nice find.

Just as I was about to say it was a 
coincidence, a playful thought struck me. 
Since I have the chance, I might as well 
give her a proper scare.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "Not bad. I shall grant you praise."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: And so.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Making a shell of that size normally takes 
over two months... How did you shorten the 
time?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. If you wish to deceive me, first 
wipe that smirk off your face.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what shall your punishment 
be...? The crime of rebellion is severe.
choice_data_list: Ugh, please go easy on me...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I've decided.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Next year, bring me a chocolate as grand 
as those fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You must be quite fond of this King.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Then—put in the effort.

"If I hadn't gone out into town and tried 
gathering info solely on social media... I 
might never have found it."
choice_data_list: It was just a coincidence, pure luck.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: There are no coincidences.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Everything is inevitable. Or perhaps—you 
brought this upon yourself.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
There is no reason you would be out of 
luck.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —I have met my lifelong King.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Standing side by side with the King, we 
watch the fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Could there be any fortune greater than 
this?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: None.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "Say it with certainty. ...You fool."

Orfevre smiles with absolute confidence. 
Under the colorful glow of the 
fireworks... she was shining brilliantly, 
like a kaleidoscope.
